summary: Explicit-mode /z-plan and adaptive INTENT execution model: /z-plan records Intent-vs-Full SDD before cost gating, writes INTENT.md plus initial TASKS.md in intent mode, may surface non-auto-dispatch route recommendations after artifacts, writes HANDOFF.md after TASKS, and /z-execute freezes INTENT for BFS execution with LEDGER checkpoints.

entry_points.summary: Validate frontmatter and required sections by intent level.
Set frozen_at back to pending for amended contracts.
Stamp frozen_at idempotently; reports FROZEN or ALREADY_FROZEN.
Create LEDGER.md frontmatter if absent without overwriting existing content.
Evaluate checklist criteria from INTENT, LEDGER citations, and cumulative diff.
Visible Intent-vs-Full SDD choice before hard cost gate; config/flags preselect.
Intent mode dispatches task-tree-generator for level-0 TASKS.md; full mode writes legacy tasks.
May recommend split, sharpen, or brainstorm; route gate never auto-dispatches.
Writes HANDOFF.md after TASKS sanity and post-artifact route checks.
User chooses fresh execute, audit first, stop with handoff, or amend.
SPEC.md present -> legacy; INTENT.md present -> intent; neither -> halt.
Freeze INTENT and snapshot to archive/INTENT.frozen.md on first freeze.
Generate BFS levels from frozen INTENT, LEDGER, unmet criteria, and prior outcomes.
Marks TASKS.md stale so task-tree-generator regenerates after amended contract.

invariants: Config and flags recommend planning mode; /z-plan records the actual explicit mode choice before hard cost gating unless unattended/no-ask binds the recommendation.
SPEC.md presence forces legacy full SDD mode for that slug.
Intent-mode /z-plan writes INTENT.md with frozen_at: pending plus an initial canonical TASKS.md generated by task-tree-generator.
INTENT is frozen at execution boundary, not continuously mutable.
LEDGER is append-only audit trail for realized BFS execution.
Post-artifact route checks and final handoff choices are non-auto-dispatch user gates.
HANDOFF.md is written after TASKS and before finalization; it indexes context but does not replace INTENT/SPEC/PLAN/TASKS.
Unknown acceptance state counts as unmet.
workflow.intent_parallel_levels controls within-level sibling dispatch only.
gotchas: workflow.intent_bfs_level_cap is runtime-read and may not appear in DEFAULTS; empty/None falls back to 6.
stale_reason: amended-intent must replace any existing key, not duplicate it.
/z-plan Phase 8.4 can recommend /z-sharpen or /z-brainstorm for question-heavy/unsettled artifacts, but it never launches them.
Final gate options recommend commands for the user/fresh session; /z-plan itself does not start /z-execute, /z-audit-plan, or /z-amend.
Do not pass spec_path/plan_path to implementers in INTENT mode.

config_keys.workflow.planning_mode: intent|full recommendation for the explicit mode gate
config_keys.workflow.intent_level: auto|quick|standard|deep; level flags override and bypass classifier
config_keys.workflow.hermes_enabled: bool master gate for Hermes machinery
